story.title: Namangan - the address of quality
story.p1: AKSAM began in 2020 as a small weaving workshop. Today it is a production complex with modern European equipment, supplying garment manufacturers and brands across Uzbekistan.
story.p2: Our principle is simple: every batch passes ISO-standard inspection and every order ships on time. That is why 99.8% of our clients come back.
